pages.title: Ancient Guardians
pages.text: $(curse)Boss entities$() are powerful beings that guard the greatest treasures. They require preparation, strategy, and powerful equipment to defeat.$(br2)$(warning)Do not engage without proper gear!

pages.name: Djeserhath
pages.text: Ancient guardian with divine protection. A formidable opponent.

pages.name: Withered Pharaoh
pages.text: Undead pharaoh with dark magic. Commands wither effects.

pages.name: Zulmak
pages.text: Controls locusts and cursed earth. Summons minions and creates vortexes.
